title: DoorDash Sweet Treat Week: How to Get Deals on Starbucks, Wendy’s & Häagen-Dazs
summary: Running through July 22, the DoorDash promotion offers exclusive savings for DashPass members during the final week of Summer of DashPass.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

If you’ve been craving an iced coffee, Frosty or late-night ice cream run, DoorDash is making those sweet treats a little easier on your wallet. As part of its eight-week Summer of DashPass campaign celebrating the FIFA World Cup 202 , DoorDash is rolling out Sweet Treat Week from July 16 through July 22, giving DashPass members access to exclusive savings from popular chains including Starbucks, McDonald’s, Wendy’s, Häagen-Dazs and more.

During Sweet Treat Week, DashPass members can take advantage of limited-time offers from some of their favorite restaurants and snack brands, including:

- Starbucks: $10 off orders of $25 or more

- Tropical Smoothie Cafe: Free smoothie with $20 purchase

- Häagen-Dazs: Buy two products and save $4

- Wendy’s: Free Frosty with a $20 purchase

- Taco Bell: Free Crunchwrap Supreme with $22 purchase

- Wawa: 30% off orders of $25 or more (up to $12 off)

- McDonald’s: Buy one, get one Big Mac or 10-piece Chicken McNuggets

The promotion marks the final week of DoorDash’s Summer of DashPass event , which has paired food deals with FIFA-inspired experiences throughout the tournament. While the limited-time discounts are a major draw, they’re only available to DashPass members, making the subscription the key to unlocking savings on everything from coffee runs and desserts to groceries and everyday essentials.

Whether you’re ordering a sweet treat for yourself or stocking up for a FIFA World Cup finale watch party, DashPass gives DoorDash customers more ways to save throughout the summer and beyond.

Offers vary by participating merchant and location. Terms and conditions apply.
